comparison.objective: Tune a shock absorber versus select conveyor parts and assemble a pictured model.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tool engagement and response-based adjustment versus timed interception, look-alike discrimination, temporary parking, and stacking.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeatable stops versus correct four-part assembly while extras leave the belt and no part is held back long enough to jam it.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap exists beyond general grasping and placement. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift tolerances remain undeclared.
